t: When Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, returned from (the battle of) Siffin and noticed the graves outside Kufah, he said : O Residents of houses which give a sense of loneliness, of depopulated areas and gloomy graves. O People of the dust; O Victims of strangeness, O People of loneliness and O People of Desolateness! You have gone ahead and precede us while we are following you and will meet you. The houses (you left) have been inhabited by others; the wives (you left) have been married by others; the properties have been distributed (among heirs). This is the news about those around us; what is the news about things around you ? Then Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, turned to his companions and said : Beware If they were allowed to speak they would inform you that : Verily, the best provision is fear of Allah. (Qur'an, 2:197)
